what: From when this section’s top edge crosses the 80% line from the bottom of the screen until its bottom edge reaches the 40% line, a dark veil covers the whole screen (inside the frame) over 1s, then lifts over 1s once it leaves — it darkens the pinned photo so white text stays readable as the text section rises over it.

options.start: Position where the veil turns on (ScrollTrigger start), default ”top 80%”
options.end: Where the veil turns off (ScrollTrigger end), default bottom 40%
options.--fx-veil: Curtain color (css variable, in :root), default 30% of the text color
options.--fx-inset: Screen edge offset (css variable) — if there is a white border around it, its thickness

use: <section data-fx="pass-veil">Section with white text rising over a photo</section> — Curtain variables go on :root (only one curtain is attached, at the end of body)
